# `/accounts` endpoints

Base URL: `https://{tenant}.api.identitynow.com`

### GET /accounts/v1

`listAccountsV1` — Accounts list

List accounts.

- Scopes: idn:accounts:manage, idn:accounts:read
- User levels: ORG_ADMIN, SOURCE_ADMIN, SOURCE_SUBADMIN, HELPDESK
- Parameters:
  - `limit` (query) — max 250 — default 250 — Max number of results to return. See [API Standard Collection Parameters](https://developer.sailpoint.com/docs/api/standard-collection-parameters) for more information.
  - `offset` (query) — default 0 — Offset into the full result set. Usually specified with *limit* to paginate through the results. See [API Standard Collection…
  - `count` (query) — default False — If *true* it will populate the *X-Total-Count* response header with the number of results that would be returned if *limit* and *offset* were ignored. Since requesting a total count can have a…
  - `detailLevel` (query) — one of SLIM, FULL — This value determines whether the API provides `SLIM` or increased level of detail (`FULL`) for each account in the returned list. `FULL` is the default behavior.
  - `filters` (query) — fields: id: eq, in, sw; identityId: eq, in, sw; name: eq, in, sw; nativeIdentity: eq, in, sw; hasEntitlements: eq; sourceId: eq, in, sw; uncorrelated: eq; entitlements: eq; origin: eq, in; manuallyCorrelated: eq; identity.name: eq, in, sw; identity.correlated: eq; identity.identityState: eq, in; source.displayableName: eq, in; source.authoritative: eq; source.connectionType: eq, in; recommendation.method: eq, in, isnull; created: eq, ge, gt, le, lt; modified: eq, ge, gt, le, lt — e.g. `identityId eq "2c9180858082150f0180893dbaf44201"`
  - `sorters` (query) — fields: id, name, created, modified, sourceId, identityId, nativeIdentity, uuid, manuallyCorrelated, entitlements, origin, identity.name, identity.identityState, identity.correlated, source.displayableName, source.authoritative, source.connectionType — e.g. `id,name`
- Returns 200: array of account

### POST /accounts/v1

`createAccountV1` — Create account

Submit an account creation task - the API then returns the task ID. You must include the `sourceId` where the account will be created in the `attributes` object. This endpoint creates an account on the source record in your SailPoint Identity Security tenant. This is useful for Flat File (`DelimitedFile`) type sources because it allows you to aggregate new accounts without needing to import a new CSV file every time. However, if you use this endpoint to create an account for a Direct…

- Scopes: idn:accounts:manage
- User levels: ORG_ADMIN, SOURCE_ADMIN, SOURCE_SUBADMIN
- Body (application/json): accountattributescreate
- Returns 202: accountsasyncresult

### GET /accounts/v1/{id}

`getAccountV1` — Account details

Use this API to return the details for a single account by its ID.

- Scopes: idn:accounts:manage, idn:accounts:read
- User levels: ORG_ADMIN, SOURCE_ADMIN, SOURCE_SUBADMIN, HELPDESK
- Parameters:
  - `id` (path, required) — Account ID.
- Returns 200: account

### PATCH /accounts/v1/{id}

`updateAccountV1` — Update account

Use this API to update account details. This API supports updating an account's correlation by modifying the `identityId` and `manuallyCorrelated` fields. To reassign an account from one identity to another, replace the current `identityId` with a new value. If the account you're assigning was provisioned by SailPoint Identity Security, it's possible for SailPoint Identity Security to create a new account for the previous identity as soon as the account is moved. If the account you're…

- Scopes: idn:accounts:manage
- User levels: ORG_ADMIN, SOURCE_ADMIN, SOURCE_SUBADMIN
- Parameters:
  - `id` (path, required) — Account ID.
- Body (application/json-patch+json): array of object
- Returns 202: object

### PUT /accounts/v1/{id}

`putAccountV1` — Update account

Use this API to update an account with a PUT request. This endpoint submits an account update task and returns the task ID. >**Note: You can only use this PUT endpoint to update accounts from flat file sources.**

- Scopes: idn:accounts:manage
- User levels: ORG_ADMIN, SOURCE_ADMIN, SOURCE_SUBADMIN
- Parameters:
  - `id` (path, required) — Account ID.
- Body (application/json): accountattributes
- Returns 202: accountsasyncresult

### DELETE /accounts/v1/{id}

`deleteAccountV1` — Delete account

Use this API to delete an account. This endpoint submits an account delete task and returns the task ID. This endpoint only deletes the account from IdentityNow, not the source itself, which can result in the account's returning with the next aggregation between the source and IdentityNow. To avoid this scenario, it is recommended that you [disable accounts](https://developer.sailpoint.com/docs/api/disable-account-v-1) rather than delete them. This will also allow you to reenable the accounts…

- Scopes: idn:accounts:manage
- User levels: ORG_ADMIN, SOURCE_ADMIN, SOURCE_SUBADMIN
- Parameters:
  - `id` (path, required) — Account ID.
- Returns 202: accountsasyncresult

### POST /accounts/v1/{id}/reload

`submitReloadAccountV1` — Reload account

This API asynchronously reloads the account directly from the connector and performs a one-time aggregation process.

- Scopes: idn:accounts-state:manage
- User levels: ORG_ADMIN, SOURCE_ADMIN, SOURCE_SUBADMIN, HELPDESK
- Parameters:
  - `id` (path, required) — The account id
- Returns 202: accountsasyncresult

`enableAccountV1` — Enable account

### POST /accounts/v1/{id}/unlock

`unlockAccountV1` — Unlock account

This API submits a task to unlock an account and returns the task ID. To use this endpoint to unlock an account that has the `forceProvisioning` option set to true, the `idn:accounts-provisioning:manage` scope is required.

- Scopes: idn:accounts-state:manage
- User levels: ORG_ADMIN, SOURCE_ADMIN, SOURCE_SUBADMIN, HELPDESK
- Parameters:
  - `id` (path, required) — The account ID.
- Body (application/json): accountunlockrequest
- Returns 202: accountsasyncresult

### POST /accounts/v1/{id}/remove

`deleteAccountAsyncV1` — Remove account

Use this endpoint to remove accounts from the system without provisioning changes to the source. Accounts that are removed could be re-created during the next aggregation. This endpoint is good for: * Removing accounts that no longer exist on the source. * Removing accounts that won't be aggregated following updates to the source configuration. * Forcing accounts to be re-created following the next aggregation to re-run account processing, support testing, etc.

- Scopes: idn:accounts:manage
- User levels: ORG_ADMIN
- Parameters:
  - `id` (path, required) — The account id
- Returns 202: taskresultdto

### POST /accounts/v1/{id}/classify

`sendClassifyMachineAccountV1` — Classify single machine account — **EXPERIMENTAL (header `X-SailPoint-Experimental: true`)**

Use this API to classify a single machine account. A token with API, ORG_ADMIN, SOURCE_ADMIN, or SOURCE_SUBADMIN authority is required to call this API.

- Scopes: idn:account:update
- User levels: API, ORG_ADMIN, SOURCE_ADMIN, SOURCE_SUBADMIN
- Parameters:
  - `id` (path, required) — Account ID.
  - `classificationMode` (query) — default default — one of default, ignoreManual, forceMachine, forceHuman — Specifies how the accounts should be classified. default - uses criteria to classify account as machine or human, excludes accounts that were manually classified. ignoreManual - like default, but…
- Returns 200: object

### POST /accounts/v1/bulk-classify

`sendBulkClassifyMachineAccountsV1` — Classify multiple machine accounts — **EXPERIMENTAL (header `X-SailPoint-Experimental: true`)**

Use this API to classify up to 250 accounts in one request. The response lists a result for each requested account, with its own status code, so some accounts can succeed while others fail. A token with API, ORG_ADMIN, SOURCE_ADMIN, or SOURCE_SUBADMIN authority is required to call this API. When machine account classification is not enabled for the tenant, this API returns `404`.

- Scopes: idn:accounts:classify
- User levels: ORG_ADMIN, SOURCE_ADMIN, SOURCE_SUBADMIN
- Parameters:
  - `classificationMode` (query) — default default — one of default, ignoreManual, forceMachine, forceHuman — Specifies how the accounts should be classified. default - uses criteria to classify account as machine or human, excludes accounts that were manually classified. ignoreManual - like default, but…
- Body (application/json): bulkclassifymachineaccountsrequest

### GET /accounts/v1/{id}/recommendation

`getMachineAccountRecommendationV1` — Get machine account recommendation — **EXPERIMENTAL (header `X-SailPoint-Experimental: true`)**

This API returns the machine account discovery recommendation for an account. The recommendation states whether the account is likely a machine account and lists the reasons that contributed to it. When no recommendation exists for the account, this API returns `200` with an empty response body. When machine account discovery is not enabled for the tenant, this API returns `404`.

- Scopes: idn:accounts:manage, idn:accounts:read
- User levels: ORG_ADMIN, SOURCE_ADMIN, SOURCE_SUBADMIN, HELPDESK
- Parameters:
  - `id` (path, required) — Account ID.
- Returns 200: machineaccountrecommendation

`createSearchAttributeConfigV1` — Create extended search attributes

It will then validate the inputs and configure/create the attribute promotion configuration in the Link ObjectConfig. >**Note: Give searchable attributes unique names. Do not give them the same names used for account attributes or source attributes. Also, do not give them the same names present in account…

- User levels: ORG_ADMIN
- Body (application/json): searchattributeconfig
- Returns 202: object
